Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM Center, EDSA corner Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City http: //www.dilg.com.ph 11 SEP OPINION NO. 58 SHEENA MARIE B. ORACOY Acting SK Chaiperson Barangay Talungon, Bais City Negros Oriental Dear SK Chairperson Oracoy: S. This is in reference to your letter dated 30 January 2019 to Dir. Leocadio T. Trovela of DILG Region VII inquiring on whether an acting SK Chairperson can receive an honorarium. In your case, the SK Chairperson was not proclaimed due to a pending disqualification case, therefore his position will be considered temporarily vacant. Thereafter, the SK member who obtained the highest number of votes shall succeed in the Office of SK Chairperson. However, since that the vacancy is only temporary, the said SK Member shall succeed in an acting capacity. Hence, being the first ranking sanggunian member, you are considered as the Acting Sangguniang Kabataan Chairperson of Barangay Talungon, Bais City. Before we answer your query, it is important to know the nature of "Acting Capacity! In Civil Service Commission (CSC) Resolution 0007781 Officer-in-charge was differentiated from Acting Capacity, viz: "It must be noted that a designation under acting capacity may be differentiated from a designation as Officer-in-Charge (OIC) in such a manner that an OIC enjoys limited powers which are confined to functions of administration and ensuring that the office continues its usual activities. The OIC may not be deemed to possess the power to appoint employees as the same involves the exercise of discretion which is beyond the power of an OIC. On the other hand xxx, a designation in an acting capacity. entails not only the exercise ofthe ministerial functions attached to the pqsition but also the exercise of discretion. considering that the person designated is deemed te be the incumbent Of the " (emphasis ours) VITRIOLO, Julito D Re: Query; Position Title; Nomenclature Distinction between Acting and OIC, 24 march 2000

In relation thereto, Section 16 (b) of RA 10742 otherwise known as the SK Reform Law Of 2015, provides that the Sangguniang Kabataan Chairperson shall have the same privileges enjoyed by other Sangguniang Barangay officials subject to such requirements and limitations provided by the same law. This privileges can also be extended to the acting SK Chairperson as he/she is considered incumbent to said position, though temporary. Under the Local Government Code, honorarium is one of the privileges of the barangay officials, viz: Section 393. Benefits of Barangay Officials. - (a Baran a officials includin baran a tanods and mem rs of the Iu n tagaæma_yapa. shall receive honoraria, allowances, and such other emoluments as may be authorized by law or barangay, municipal or city ordinance in accordance with the provisions of this Code, but in no case shall it be less than One thousand pesos (P 1,000.00) per month for the punong barangay and Six hundred pesos (P600.OO) per month for the sangguniang barangay members, barangay treasurer, and barangay secretary: Provided, however, That the annual appropriations for personal services shall be subject to the budgetary limitations prescribed under Title Five, Book II of this Code; Moreover, Honorarium, as defined by the Government Accounting and Auditing Manual (GAAM), is that remuneration given to public official (Emphasis ours) Comes now to your query on whether the Acting SK Chairperson can receive an honorarium. It can be gleaned from the discussions above that barangay officials, including SK Chairperson are entitled to honorarium (not salary), and which can also be extended to the Acting SK Chairperson. Hence, this Department opines in affirmative. Thus, if you were present in the sangguniang barangay sessions and had rendered actual services as Acting SK Chairperson and ex-officio member of the Sangguniang Barangay, certainly, you will be entitled to an honorarium. Thank you. MARIVEL Unders Copy furnished: Dir. Leocadio T. Trovela Regional Director DILG Region VII Sudlon, Lahug, Cebu City LIIs,'37 2 DILG Opinion No. 2, s. 2012 Very truly yours, . SACENDONCILLO, CESO 111 retary for Local Government
